## Summary

I implemented dynamic placeholder resolution for JDBC connection strings in the BeakerX SQL kernel, allowing sensitive values (credentials) to be pulled from shared notebook variables instead of being hardcoded.

So `...?user={$beakerx.dbuser}&password={$beakerx.dbpassword}` becomes `...?user=user1&password=user1password` when `dbuser`/`dbpassword` are set.
